description: Zones d’accélération de la production d’énergie renouvelables (ZAER) sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Les zones d’accélération de la production d’énergie renouvelables (ZAER) constituent un dispositif de planification territoriale introduits par la loi n° 2023-175 du 10 mars 2023 relative à l’accélération de la production d’énergies renouvelables, dite loi « APER ». Coverage: Rennes Métropole en accès libre. The publisher named on the listing is Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Its keywords include source-denergie-renouvelable, reseaux-energie, production-denergie. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2023-12-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
